evidence.quote: Two important such tools that have been adopted by the Federal Reserve since the onset of the financial crisis are stress testing and firm-specific capital planning.
In this regard, it is important to reemphasize that the stress scenario is not a forecast of what will happen.
Stress testing and regular capital review exercises have already become key components of our supervisory program for large bank holding companies.
